analysis.one_line_summary: A static Black Friday promo graphic featuring a redheaded woman styling her bouncy curls with a pink Wavytalk thermal blowout brush alongside an 'up to 31% off' badge.
analysis.full_description: Static promotional creative for Black Friday by Wavytalk. On the right, a smiling woman with styled auburn/red wavy hair holds a pink Wavytalk thermal round brush wrapped around a section of her hair. On the left side against a clean white background, dark bold text reads 'WAVYTALK', 'Black Friday', and '10mins to Bouncy Hair', accented by a circular yellow badge highlighting 'UP TO 31% OFF'.

scenes.visual: A smiling young adult woman with ginger/auburn bouncy hair wearing a black square-neck top, holding a pink thermal round styling brush wrapped around a lock of hair near her crown. Text overlays with Black Friday discount badge are on the left on a plain light background.
scenes.action: Posing smiling towards the camera with the styling brush in her hair.
